pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā channo sayaṃ anācāraṃ ācaritvā saṅghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.3: ko āpanno kiṃ āpanno kismiṃ āpanno kathaṃ āpanno kaṃ bhaṇatha kiṃ bhaṇathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā channo saṅghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññenaññaṃ paṭicarissati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.6: ko āpanno kiṃ āpanno kismiṃ āpanno kathaṃ āpanno kaṃ bhaṇatha kiṃ bhaṇathāti. athakho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. athakho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ channaṃ paṭipucchi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.7: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ channa saṅghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññenaññaṃ paṭicarasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.11: hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa saṅghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññenaññaṃ paṭicarissasi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.16: tenahi bhikkhave saṅgho channassa bhikkhuno aññavādakaṃ ropetu.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.20: ayaṃ channo bhikkhu saṅghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.21: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho channassa bhikkhuno aññavādakaṃ ropeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.24: ayaṃ channo bhikkhu saṅghamajjhe āpattiyā anuyuñjiyamāno aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.26: yassāyasmato khamati channassa bhikkhuno aññavādakassa ropanā so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.29: khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.30: athakho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ channaṃ anekapariyāyena vigarahitvā dubbharatāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.31: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:1.33: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.2: saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati ko āpanno kiṃ āpanno kismiṃ āpanno kathaṃ āpanno kaṃ bhaṇatha kiṃ bhaṇathāti eso aññavādako nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.4: saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo tuṇhībhūto saṅghaṃ viheseti eso vihesako nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.5.1: aropite aññavādake saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati

pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.7: aropite vihesake saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo tuṇhībhūto saṅghaṃ viheseti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.8: ropite aññavādake saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo aññenaññaṃ paṭicarati
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.9: ko āpanno …pe… kiṃ bhaṇathāti āpatti pācittiyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc12:3.1.10: ropite vihesake saṅghamajjhe vatthusmiṃ vā āpattiyā vā anuyuñjiyamāno taṃ na kathetukāmo taṃ na ugghāṭetukāmo tuṇhībhūto saṅghaṃ viheseti āpatti pācittiyassa.
